answer: Because the wander stake is held until the tide settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the horizon audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 14% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A farm running 50 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
